book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌe Pilato Vaḡe Tutune Onamiro
Oherebau uzeuze dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa nuꞌoranadu Iesu manoga veize ḡoere idaniro.
Ze ani autadu Roma gavana vazeḡa Pilato vaḡe tutune onamiro ebu ane ꞌevora riꞌiniro.
Iudaꞌa Ane Bare Bodaniro

Iesu revoharoteꞌe vazeḡa Iudaꞌa Iesuꞌe runeo tuḡuniꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa igirotene, ani haḡaiḡa sauꞌa uꞌano aneꞌa bare zamaḡaniꞌa adudaro. Eꞌanoꞌo siliva hadiḡa 30 madu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboro bare ziniro.

Ebu aneꞌa ziro, “E haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeha, mazaḡa eḡeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa oꞌoꞌa vazeḡa revohanadu ani runeo tuḡuneha.” ꞌOugadu zeḡeꞌa niro, “Aꞌe emeḡeꞌa mene haḡaeha, rehano ḡaeꞌa bare haḡaeha. Ḡae edeḡano haḡaoꞌi.”
ꞌOugirotene, Iudaꞌa kuru neḡa zamaḡano hadiḡa feuniro ebu onamadu aneꞌa bare bodane runiro.
Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa hadiḡa madu reiro, “Hadi ꞌadiꞌe vaze matihi radu haroteꞌe hadiḡa ꞌahine, kuru neḡa hadiḡa teite tibune tougaꞌe mene idaḡa.”
Zeḡeꞌa ꞌouge ḡoꞌaniroteꞌe enogano, eꞌe hadiḡa hina ḡoḡore haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa haba ꞌahoga hoitadu eꞌe habaꞌano avoꞌa azaḡa guriꞌuma rae reiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo haba aꞌe Ru Habaꞌa rae hunadu izidi zuni deꞌuge rae huneꞌohe.
ꞌOugadu Badiꞌaꞌa peroveta vazeḡa Ieremiaonoꞌo reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudaro, “Zeḡeꞌa siliva hadiḡa 30 meiro. Aꞌe Isaraela azaḡaniꞌa vaze eꞌe naeḡa rae ohoniroteꞌe hadiḡa.
Ebu Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ihiroteꞌe teige, zeꞌa hadi eꞌe hina ḡoḡore haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa haba hoitiro.”
Iesuꞌe Pilato zamao Kotaniro
Ebu Iesuꞌe Roma gavana vazeḡa Pilato zamao edau radiro. Ebu Pilatoꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Ḡaꞌe Iuda azaḡa kinihe?” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Oꞌe, ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare eꞌe kini rae raha.”
Rehano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa Iesuꞌe veꞌoḡa rae riḡa ḡoerirotene, Iesuꞌe mene naenaeziro.
Hena Pilatoꞌa ḡadiniro, “Zeꞌa ḡaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ḡehaḡa rae fureneꞌohe. Ḡa mene igiꞌehe?”
Rehano Iesuꞌa zeḡe ḡoere tiba zuni mene naenaeziro. ꞌOugadu Pilatoꞌa zaguzagau huniro.
Iesu Runeo Tuḡuniꞌuma Reiro
Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡano Roma gavana vazeḡaꞌe Iuda azaḡaniꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe ḡuꞌa vazeḡa ꞌahoga tuḡune bunido.
Eꞌe madaḡano ḡuꞌa neḡano vaze ꞌahoga, niḡa Barabasiꞌa radiunu. Vaze niduꞌa ani ederiro.
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa nuꞌorarotene, Pilatoꞌa ḡadiziro, “Za uraꞌe eḡeꞌa iniu tuḡune buniꞌuma, Barabasi ga Keriso raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa Iesu?”
Mazaḡa Pilatoꞌe zeꞌa Iesu ahiahiniroteꞌe uꞌano, ani riꞌinirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro.

Pilatoꞌa kota habaꞌano ehorinuteꞌe zamaḡano inuganiꞌa ani veize ḡoere tuḡuriro, “Ḡa veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa vazeḡa eꞌe mazao haḡai sauꞌa ꞌahoga ago haḡaoꞌi. Eꞌe ohoḡore ohere iḡunao ani uꞌano zamaheꞌa ufeta adudaneha.”
Rehano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa Barabasi tuḡune bunadu Iesu manoga veize vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Pilato uminoga tuḡutuḡuziro.
Pilatoꞌa ḡadiziro, “Vaze aheu boꞌaḡano zaꞌe eḡeꞌa iniu tuḡune bunoga urateꞌohe?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Barabasi!”
Ebu Pilatoꞌa ḡadiziro, “Tena e Keriso raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa Iesu mazaoꞌe nougiꞌuma?” Zeḡe niduꞌa niro, “Aniꞌe Satauronoꞌi!”
Pilatoꞌa ḡadiziro, “Nougadu? Ani haḡai sauꞌa nagiga haḡairo?” Rehano zeḡeꞌa ufeta ḡihau huaro, “Satauronoꞌi!”

Pilatoꞌe Iesu veize gauni ꞌahoga haḡaogaꞌe mene idaḡa reirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro. Ebu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ufeta maḡune haraeꞌeteꞌe horonirotene, zeḡe ubumao vu tahiḡa madu ꞌevoꞌa vuzuꞌiro ebu ziro, “E vaze ꞌahaꞌa rudatiteꞌe moneo veꞌoḡa ꞌahoga mene haḡaeha. Zae daꞌo eꞌe naeḡa moꞌi.”
ꞌOugadu vaze niduꞌa naenaeniro, “Ani rudaune, eꞌe naeḡaꞌe emeḡe zu marigafeꞌa meꞌuma!”
Eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌe zeḡe veize Barabasi ḡuꞌa neḡanonoꞌo tuḡune buniro, rehano Iesuꞌe masiniroteꞌe enogano satauronoga veize uti azaḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniro.
Uti Azaḡaniꞌa Iesu Ḡirihoharo
Gavana uti azaḡa nuꞌa Iesuꞌe gavana ne zamaḡa tutune onamiro, ebu uti azaḡa niduꞌa ani zamao huze nuꞌoziro.
Ebu ze Iesu dabua fuhiꞌohanadu dabua kanaḡa duhuḡa hune vidoharo.

Ebu ire ezaga meigameiga ḡurunadu kini vadiga adiriḡa teige vadigano redoharo, zu Gubu somoriḡa edaꞌe ꞌevoꞌano obonoharo. Ebu obenaze hina ani mazao ḡuḡureꞌenaꞌa ḡirihoharo, “Iuda azaḡa kini, nigunihi!”
Ebu ze ani rana soꞌabide vaniro zu Gubu somoriḡa eꞌe madu vadiga rana barebare bouniro.
Ḡirihohau hauḡirotene, ani vidoharoteꞌe dabuaḡa fuhiꞌadu ane dabua bare vidoharo. Ebu satauronoga radu tutune onamiro.
Iesu Satauroniro
Uti azaḡaniꞌa Iesu tutune onamiroteꞌe zamaḡano Kurene vazeḡa ꞌahoga, niḡa Simona hidiro, ebu aniꞌa Iesu satauro herate onamoga veize tuḡutuḡuniro.
Ebu ze Gologota rae huneꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano feuriro (Gologota hugaꞌe Vadini Isiga Haba'a).
Eꞌea ze vaini vuḡa ḡau ꞌahoga ḡiḡiꞌa bagaḡa teite mirunadu gagoharo. Rehano aneꞌa tahiḡa gage nuradu gagoga mene uratiro.
Zeḡeꞌa Iesu satauroniroteꞌe ḡarugano kaḡusi arahoḡa arahadu Iesu dabua ḡahugotitiro.
Ebu eꞌea ze ehoradu Iesu ḡiane radiro.
Ze Iesu haḡai sauꞌaꞌe nagini rae ihozifine ane satauro hitagano ꞌahige mirihadu tiro, “ꞌADIꞌE IESU, IUDA AZAḠ KINI.”
Ebu ḡonore azaḡa aheu zuni ani teite satauroziro. ꞌAhogaꞌe ane edaꞌe moneo zu ꞌahogaꞌe ane kauri moneo ikokoziro.
Ebu uhiḡano vitau onamiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa vadinize miruneꞌenaꞌa, Iesu rae sausauniro,
“Ḡaꞌe kuru neḡa fahadu mada uḡidu zamaḡano bare ohoniꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡa. Ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare ḡaboꞌoꞌi! Ḡa Badiꞌa Ubuga roꞌidene, satauronoꞌo buau ovaoꞌi!”
Eꞌe teige, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa zuni ḡirihohauꞌenaꞌa ḡoeriro,
“Aniꞌa vaze nunu ḡaboziro, rehano ani aneꞌa bare ḡabonogaꞌe mene idaḡa! Aniꞌe Iuda azaḡa kini, eꞌanoꞌo izidi hune satauronoꞌo bua ovaoꞌi, ꞌougine eme ani mazao fiꞌuma!
Aniꞌe Badiꞌa mazao fieꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa uratine izidi ani ḡaboniꞌuma, mazaḡa aneꞌa raenaꞌa, 'E Badiꞌa Ubuga,' rae reiro.”
Zeḡe teige, Iesu teite idaḡa satauroziroteꞌe ḡonore azaḡaniꞌa zuni ani rae sausauniro.
Iesu Rune
Madai kirikiri meirotene, haba niduꞌa uzaboꞌa ꞌuiro, onamo ḡorava mone mada uḡidu.
Ḡorava madaḡa uḡidu meirotene, Iesuꞌa ḡihau huaro, “Eli, Eli, lama sabatani?” Ḡoere eꞌe hugaꞌe, “Eḡe Badiꞌa, eḡe Badiꞌa, ḡa nougadu eḡe modeha?”
Eꞌea edau radiroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano nuꞌe ḡoere eꞌe egadu reiro, “Aniꞌa Elia huneꞌohe.”
Ebu zeḡe boꞌaḡano ꞌahoganiꞌa zogone dure onamadu vu romane zouneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa meiro, ebu vaini vuḡa ḡiḡiꞌa iriꞌavonadu Gubu somoriḡa rana tiro, ebu Iesu gagoharo.
Rehano vaze nuꞌe reiro, “Ani modoꞌi. Eliaꞌa ovadu ḡaboniꞌuma ga mene, ḡianihi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa agoḡa boro hina bare ḡihau huanadu iriga riꞌiro.
Eꞌe madaḡano kuru neḡano Haba Zaḡoḡa Hune ꞌueꞌeteꞌe dabuaḡaniꞌa hitaganonoꞌo ꞌuꞌuḡa ḡuzu zigau ꞌaꞌadaro. Ebu rahaꞌa hagariro zu vatavaꞌa ꞌaꞌadanadu bohatu ḡouriro.
Ebu rune iduḡa ꞌaꞌadanadu Badiꞌa mone azaḡa ḡehaḡa ahirizeꞌa ḡabode iḡune ḡouriro.
Ze iduzeonoꞌo buaro, ebu Iesuꞌa bare ḡabodiroteꞌe enogano Ierusalema onamadu vaze ḡehaḡa zamao fureraro.
Uti vazeḡa boro zu ane teite Iesu ḡiane radiroteꞌe uti azaḡaꞌe rahaꞌa hagariroteꞌe zu naginiꞌa fureraroteꞌe horonirotene, rihau rudanadu reiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe hube hune Badiꞌa Ubuga!”
Eꞌea roḡae ḡehaḡaniꞌa zuni faḡanonoꞌo ehamu radiro. Zeꞌe Iesu dananoga veize Galilea habaꞌanonoꞌo hegote ariro.
Zeḡe boꞌaḡano Magadala roḡaeḡa Maria, ebu Iakobo zu Iosefa vize Maria, ebu Zebedeo ubugaubuga Iakobo zu Ioane vizeꞌa radiunu.
Iesu Guriro
Ḡoravararotene, maꞌora vazeḡa, niḡa Iosefaꞌa ariro. Aniꞌe Arimate vazeḡa zu Iesu tahiꞌa ꞌahoga.
Aniꞌa Pilato vaḡe onamadu Iesu ahiri mouga veize uminiro, ebu Pilatoꞌa ḡoere tuḡuradu Iesu ahiri haro.
ꞌOugadu Iosefaꞌa Iesu ahiri madu dabua deheḡa manoḡa hina ꞌumiro.
Ebu vatava huꞌiroteꞌe iduḡa, Iosefa ane rune iduḡa iziga zamaḡano Iesu ahiri tiro. Ebu hadi boro hina ibihetaḡano kiune ꞌuadu mode onamiro.
U Magadala roḡaeḡa Maria zu Maria ꞌahogaꞌe iduḡa zama ḡoha ehore radiro.
Uti Azaḡaniꞌa Idu Habaꞌa Ḡiane Radiro
Irarirotene, aꞌe Bana Madaḡa. Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Pilato vaḡe onamiro.
Ebu ze Pilato niro, “Vaze boro, ḡuriro vazeḡa eꞌeꞌa ꞌize ḡabode radiroteꞌe zamaḡano reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa emeꞌa zamareꞌohe. Aniꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, 'E mada uḡiduḡano bare ḡabode iḡuniꞌuma.'

Eꞌanoꞌo mada uḡidu zamaḡano uti azaḡaniꞌa ani idu faine ḡianoga veize eme umiꞌeꞌohe. Mene ꞌougine, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa aradu ani ahiri ḡonotaꞌuma ebu vaze zinaꞌa, 'Aniꞌe bare ḡabode iḡuneha,' rae reꞌuma. ꞌOugine zeꞌa vaze ufeta soꞌoziꞌuma. Aꞌe ibite soꞌozirotaꞌaꞌe vitiniꞌuma.”
Pilatoꞌa naenaeziro, “Uti azaḡa nu tutuze onamadu zae edeḡano iduḡa faine ḡiane radoꞌi.”
ꞌOugirotene, ze uti azaḡa teite onamadu iduḡa ibiheta hadiḡa boro faifaine hararo, ebu vazeꞌa mene vavaꞌifine gudune ꞌahoga tiro, ebu uti azaḡaꞌe iduḡa ḡiane radiro.
